title: Use the originally-selected time for the confirmed (too-soon-acknowledged) logDose call
description: By the time this task runs, task-017 has already rewritten the other occurrence of this exact line, so this is now the only remaining match (no occurrence needed). This is the too-soon-confirmed retry path -- it must use the time the user originally picked (now carried on PendingDoseConfirmation, task-013/018), not a fresh 'now' captured at confirm-click time.
